//: What zombies and plants drop, as PVZGE rolls it (Zombie.dropCoin/dropSprout). `drops` names each pickup: the currency it pays, how much, and its `collectable:<id>` art. `zombie` is rolled for every zombie that dies on its own side: `one_of` takes the first entry whose cumulative chance the roll falls under (PVZGE: 0.3% gem, then 0.7% gold, then 1.5% silver - 2.5% for anything), each entry of `also` rolls on its own. `feature` gates an entry on Saves.has_feature; `lod_only` keeps it to Lawn of Doom levels; `per_level` caps how many one level hands out. `mower` is what each unused lawn mower turns into when a level is won; `marigold` is a coin-producing plant's roll. A pack's loot.json replaces the keys it sets.
